title: Model IR v1.0 — MathModel Model Representation Specification
description: Machine-readable schema for MathModel Model IR / Model Graph. Covers problem binding, assumptions, variables, parameters, objectives, constraints, mechanisms, equations, dependencies, solvers, experiments, validations, claims, model graph, and modeling trace.

primary.description: Primary model family, e.g. multibody_dynamics, optimization, ode, statistical, geometric, kinematic, pde, state_space, discrete_recurrence, other
